name: Fossil Men's Black Dial Leather Strap Watch
description:
Elevate your everyday style with this striking Fossil analog watch. Designed for the modern man, it showcases a bold black dial with distinct sub-dials, gold-toned hour markers, and signature branding. The textured bezel adds a rugged yet refined touch, perfectly complemented by a durable brown leather strap.

Crafted with precision and attention to detail, this watch is suitable for both casual and formal occasions. Its versatile color palette ensures seamless pairing with various wardrobes, making it a timeless addition to any accessory collection.
